Record notes

Ten Mac workflows for recovery, verified copies, storage catalogs and memory diagnosis.

Version 0.3.0 includes 10 complete skill procedures. Complete original methods and shell helpers; receiving-host storage roles require configuration.

Requirements: macOS; Host terminal or computer-use tools.

License scope: MIT. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add mac-ops-toolkit@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from ccfc84e7affdc6a0e9990f88e92e34829403d2ff. SHA-256: 180f1a66d9a2aebe7c6fca22e83d3d47c1bf9e566bd6b4634055030e3e9d6bc4.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
